item.title: Kind of Challenging Yet Valuable Learning
item.description: In the nature of information problems, it sounds both familiar and challenging at the same time while learning. As I did Math and Computer science in my higher secondary education, the concepts like binary numbers and conversations are somehow familiar to me.It helped me to feel a kind of ease in the beginning. But when these simple concepts get distributed within the concepts like image transformation and optimization problems, it becomes more complicated and needs deeper understanding.

item.title: Seeing Information in a New Way
item.description: Learning some different things in an unusual way is kind of interesting and spectacular for me, which gets my attention even though I’m not having it. I get to know about the basic difference between the data, information, knowledge and wisdom through the DIKW model in a better way. Before I went through these terms in this unit, I thought these words are almost similar. But now the difference between them and how it depends on context, meaning, and insights was quite new to me.
